text.description_html:
Adams Rite 1830, Store Front Door Bottom Rail Swing Bolt

The Narrow Stile Bottom Rail Deadlock is used mostly on store front doors with an ultra-narrow stile or on tempered glass doors with a shallow bottom rail (shoe). This Grade 1 deadlock uses a very small latchbolt. Accepts standard Mortise Thumbturns and Mortise Lock Cylinders.

Features of the 1830 Bottom Rail Deadlock:

  • ANSI Grade 1 Lock.
  • Non-Handed
  • Key can be removed only when bolt is in a positively locked or unlocked position.
  • The Bottom Rail Deadlock can be used with with any standard 1-5/32” mortise cylinder from either (or both) sides. The Cylinder must have MS dimensioned cam.
  • The case is made from steel with corrosion-resistant plating.
  • Bolt is made from six-ply laminated steel with eight plys within case. Center ply has aluminaceramic core to deter hacksaw attack.
  • For use on metal or glass doors.
  • Comes packaged with machine screws.
  • *Cylinders and/or thumbturns as well as the strike are Sold Separately.

Specifications of the Narrow Stile Bottom Rail Swing Bolt For Store Front Doors:

  • Backset: 31/32" or 1-1/8"
  • Case Dimensions: Width - 1", Length - 6", Depth (specific to backset)
  • Latchbolt: 15/32" x 5/8" x 2-1/8" with 5/8" throw
  • Adams Rite 1830 Installation Template and Dimensional Diagram (PDF)

Sold Individually. Lock Body Only.
